drivers: Shape/fill follows a simple Latin-square distribution across rows, quickly narrowing options to two striped-arrow candidates
Rotation rule (decreasing 45° per cell within each row) must be inferred; row 3 continues cleanly from 135°, 90° to 45°
Distractor B shares the correct shape and fill but wrong rotation, so careless solvers who skip the rotation rule may err
Four identical figures per cell add visual clutter but no extra rule load; 90 s is ample
